card.title: Emotional Interest
card.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told your mother I'm scared she dislikes me. Sunday, you owe me an equally embarrassing admission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to tell her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I trusted you to risk something too. What scares you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's equal. Now tell her over lunch. Mine had an audience; yours needs one too.

card.title: Emotional Interest
card.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll help pack. I admitted sleeping in my ex's shirt hoping she'd return. Eventually I need equal honesty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does comforting me come with a bill?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Eventually. Something as hard to let me know.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I still call him. I can only tell it as a joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then save it until you can tell me what you ask for. I gave you the humiliating part.
